executive_summary: Maven compilation failed with 87 errors, identical to attempt 1. The errors persist because the root causes were not addressed: (1) Missing Lombok annotations causing absence of builder() methods and getters/setters in DTOs and entities, (2) Duplicate constructor in ColumnNotFoundException, and (3) Missing countByColumnId() implementation. The same systematic fix is required: add Lombok annotations (@Builder, @Data/@Getter/@Setter) to all affected classes, remove duplicate constructor, and implement the missing abstract method.

errors.root_cause: Duplicate constructor definition with the same signature (String parameter) exists in the ColumnNotFoundException class.
errors.fix_recommendation: Remove one of the duplicate constructors in ColumnNotFoundException.java at line 9. Keep only one constructor that accepts a String parameter.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: method builder() in 6 locations (GlobalExceptionHandler lines 26, 38, 50, 62, 79, 92)
errors.root_cause: ErrorResponse DTO is missing the builder() method, indicating @Builder annotation from Lombok is not present or not processed.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @Builder annotation to the ErrorResponse class. Ensure Lombok dependency is present in pom.xml and annotation processing is enabled in the IDE.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: multiple getter/setter methods (getId, setId, getTitle, getStatus, getUserId, getCreatedAt, getUpdatedAt, setCreatedAt, setUpdatedAt, setVersion, getVersion, getColumnId, getPriority, getDescription, getAssignee, getDueDate, builder)
errors.root_cause: Task entity is missing all getter/setter methods and builder() method. This indicates missing @Data, @Getter, @Setter, or @Builder Lombok annotations.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @Data and @Builder annotations to the Task entity class. Alternatively, add @Getter, @Setter, and @Builder separately. Ensure Lombok is properly configured.

errors.message: InMemoryTaskDataStore is not abstract and does not override abstract method countByColumnId(String)
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore implements TaskDataStore interface but does not provide implementation for the abstract method countByColumnId(String).
errors.fix_recommendation: Add the missing countByColumnId(String columnId) method implementation in InMemoryTaskDataStore class. The method should return the count of tasks for the given columnId.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: method builder() at ColumnServiceImpl line 24
errors.root_cause: ColumnTaskCountResponse DTO is missing the builder() method, indicating @Builder annotation is not present.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @Builder annotation to the ColumnTaskCountResponse class.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: method getStatus() and getColumnId() at TaskServiceImpl lines 35, 42
errors.root_cause: TaskStatusUpdateRequest DTO is missing getter methods for status and columnId fields. Missing @Data or @Getter annotation.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @Data or @Getter annotation to TaskStatusUpdateRequest class to generate getter methods for all fields.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: method builder() in multiple DTO classes (TaskStatusUpdateResponse, TaskDetailsResponse, TaskSummary, ValidateTaskMoveResponse, PagedTaskResponse, TaskCountResponse, BulkTaskResponse, TaskResponse) and missing getters in request DTOs (TaskCreateRequest, TaskUpdateRequest, ValidateTaskMoveRequest)
errors.root_cause: Multiple DTO classes used in TaskServiceImpl are missing builder() methods and getter methods. This is a widespread issue affecting 8+ DTO classes, all missing Lombok annotations.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @Builder and @Data (or @Getter) annotations to all DTO classes: TaskStatusUpdateResponse, TaskDetailsResponse, TaskSummary, ValidateTaskMoveResponse, PagedTaskResponse, TaskCountResponse, BulkTaskResponse, TaskResponse, TaskCreateRequest, TaskUpdateRequest, and ValidateTaskMoveRequest. This is a systematic issue requiring annotation addition across all DTO classes.
